eval_tech_001.subject: SSL Certificate failing on custom domain directorypro.com
eval_tech_001.body:
Hi Support,

Our custom domain directorypro.com points to Brilliant Directories, but visitors are seeing a "Not Secure" warning in Chrome. I updated the nameservers 48 hours ago. Can you verify why the automated Let's Encrypt SSL certificate is not generating?

Thanks,
Marcus

eval_tech_002.subject: Webhook endpoint returning HTTP 500 on member signup
eval_tech_002.body:
Hello,

Every time a member completes registration on our site, our Zapier webhook receives an HTTP 500 internal server error from your webhook dispatcher. Can you check the error logs for webhook ID wh_98234?

Regards,
Elena

eval_tech_003.subject: Member search results page displaying 404 error
eval_tech_003.body:
Hello Team,

When users click on the "Doctors in Chicago" search URL (/doctors/chicago), it throws a 404 page not found error. All other cities work fine. Did the permalink structure change?

Best,
Dave

eval_tech_004.subject: API rate limit exceeded response code 429
eval_tech_004.body:
Hi,

We are syncing our member database via the REST API and started receiving HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. What is the standard rate limit per minute, and how can we request an increase?

Thanks,
Sarah

eval_tech_005.subject: Images failing to upload on member profile photo upload
eval_tech_005.body:
Hello,

Our members report that uploading JPEG photos larger than 2MB fails silently with no error message. Where do I configure the max upload file size in the admin portal?

Thanks,
Oliver

eval_tech_006.subject: Google Maps API key error: RefererNotAllowedMapError
eval_tech_006.body:
Hi Support,

The map on our homepage shows "For development purposes only". In browser console I see RefererNotAllowedMapError. How do I whitelist our domain in Google Cloud Console?

Thanks,
Amira

eval_tech_007.subject: Database connection intermittent timeouts during peak traffic
eval_tech_007.body:
URGENT: Our directory site experienced 3 separate database connection drops today at 2 PM, 4 PM, and 6 PM EST. Over 50,000 visitors were on the site. Is our VPS server hitting connection limits?

Tom Bradley

eval_tech_008.subject: Custom JavaScript snippet breaking checkout form
eval_tech_008.body:
Hey,

I pasted a Google Tag Manager tracking script into the Custom Header section and now the credit card checkout button does not fire. Can you tell me which hook or header section is safe for 3rd party scripts?

Thanks,
Devin

eval_bill_001.subject: Requesting invoice receipt for last month annual renewal
eval_bill_001.body:
Hello Billing Department,

Our annual subscription renewed on October 1st for $1,450. Could you please send us the official PDF VAT receipt with our company tax registration number GB123456789?

Thank you,
Clara

eval_bill_002.subject: How to switch connected Stripe payment gateway account
eval_bill_002.body:
Hi,

We formed a new LLC and need to disconnect our old Stripe account and connect our new Stripe account. What are the exact steps in the admin portal to update the Stripe API keys?

Arthur

draft_mvazwoz2_bn954.proposedBody:
Hello Marcus Vance,

Thank you for reaching out to Brilliant Directories Support.

Regarding your inquiry about "SSL Certificate failing on custom domain directorypro.com":

To connect your live domain, navigate to Settings > Domain Manager in your admin dashboard. Enter your custom domain and point your DNS A Record to the Brilliant Directories server IP.

For detailed documentation and step-by-step guidance, please review the official Solution Center guide:
• Guide 1. How to Connect a Live Domain Name: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000065940-guide-1-how-to-connect-a-live-domain-name

You can also reference the accompanying configuration screenshot:
• Domain Manager wizard setup screen: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185668534/original/woU8C814_2yX08ziBJcQcO-54kLJi2FC_g.png?1790182288

If you need any further assistance configuring your directory, please let us know.

Best regards,
Brilliant Directories Technical Support
Brilliant Directories Support & Technical Consulting

supportingSources.title: Guide 1. How to Connect a Live Domain Name
supportingSources.snippet: The current Domain Manager guides the entire connection through up to four stages: Choose An Address, Check It, Point Domain, and Switch Over.

draft_mvazwoz2_bn954.internalExplanation: Grounded in Brilliant Directories Solution Center documentation (Guide 1. How to Connect a Live Domain Name).

draft_mvazwozq_20di8.proposedBody:
Hello Elena Rostova,

Thank you for reaching out to Brilliant Directories Support.

Regarding your inquiry about "Webhook endpoint returning HTTP 500 on member signup":

Webhooks can be configured under Developer Hub > Webhooks. Brilliant Directories supports outbound webhooks with HMAC SHA-256 signature verification.

For detailed documentation and step-by-step guidance, please review the official Solution Center guide:
• Developer Hub: Webhooks & API Integration: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000089012-webhooks

If you need any further assistance configuring your directory, please let us know.

Best regards,
Brilliant Directories Technical Support
Brilliant Directories Support & Technical Consulting

supportingSources.snippet: Configure event-driven webhooks for member signups, billing updates, and form submissions in Developer Tools > Webhooks.
